dataset: Figure/artwork submission requirements for clinical and cardiovascular journals
method: Every value was read from the journal or publisher official author-instruction page or linked official PDF/template fetched on 2026-11-14 (direct download where allowed, otherwise Firecrawl scrape). No third-party sources. Quotes are verbatim except: bracketed text [..] is an annotation added by the compiler; "..." marks omitted text; " | " separates separate passages. "not stated" means the pages read do not state it.

field_key.widths: figure widths (single / 1.5 / double column) as stated
field_key.resolution: minimum resolution at final size by image type
field_key.color_mode_and_charges: RGB vs CMYK and colour charges
field_key.special_figures: central illustration / visual / graphical abstract / cover image
field_key.chart_specific_and_unusual: chart rules, legend limits, figure-count limits
field_key.statistics_style: P-value, CI, effect-size presentation, house style manual
